description: Source code for MMC/SD card initialization and configuration in Zephyr OS, including functions for sending commands, reading/writing blocks, setting bus width, timing, and cache management.

methods.name: mmc_card_init
methods.description: Initializes an MMC card, configures voltage, bus width, timing, and cache settings.

methods.name: mmc_send_op_cond
methods.description: Sends CMD1 to query card's operational conditions.

methods.name: mmc_set_rca
methods.description: Sends CMD3 to set the relative card address.

methods.name: mmc_read_csd
methods.description: Reads the Card Specific Data (CSD) register.

methods.name: mmc_decode_csd
methods.description: Decodes raw CSD data into structured form.

methods.name: mmc_set_max_freq
methods.description: Sets maximum frequency based on CSD data.

methods.name: mmc_set_bus_width
methods.description: Configures the bus width (1, 4, or 8 bits).

methods.name: mmc_set_power_class_HS200
methods.description: Sets power class for HS200 mode.

methods.name: mmc_set_timing
methods.description: Configures card timing mode based on EXT_CSD.
